answer: Each epoch, chain picks one past answer and demands its author re-derive reasoning live under a fresh nonce, so any canned reply shatters against the new challenge like light through a prism. First, verifier samples the transcript, issues the nonce, and gives 30 seconds to produce matching derivation; mismatch flags the identity, freezing emission into a quarantine haven until manual review resolves it. Covering 11243 fake identities through this canyon of forced re-derivation costs 276209 tokens, 40 operator hours, 58 days of exposure.
